reminders.subjectPlaceholder: Leave empty for a standard subject
reminders.templateNone: None: free text, only inside the 24 hour window
reminders.templateUnknown: A template that is no longer available
reminders.templateHint: Outside 24 hours after the contact last wrote, WhatsApp only delivers an approved template. Its variables are filled in this order: 1 name, 2 service, 3 date, 4 time, 5 place, 6 join link, 7 manage link.
reminders.previewNote: An example with sample values. The real message uses the appointment's own details.
reminders.note: A reminder is never sent after the appointment starts. If the appointment is cancelled or moved, what was waiting stops and is planned again for the new time. Quiet hours hold a message until they end, and a contact who opted out or sits on the do-not-call list is skipped.
reminders.settingsDescription: For each booking type, message the contact before an appointment and follow up after it. Everything is off until you switch it on.
reminders.noTypes: There are no booking types yet. Create one to set its reminders.
reminders.conflict: This booking type was changed somewhere else. Reload to see the latest version before you save.
reminders.readOnly: You can see these reminders but not change them.

problems.offsetInvalid: Enter a whole number for the time, up to 30 days.
problems.duplicate: Each reminder or follow-up needs a different time.
problems.tooMany: At most {max} reminders and follow-ups with a time for one booking type.
problems.fallbackInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from {min} to {maxMinutes}, or leave it empty.

reminders.noneOn: No reminders or follow-ups are switched on for this booking type.

when.before: {count, plural, one {# minute before} other {# minutes before}}
when.after: {count, plural, one {# minute after} other {# minutes after}}

reasons.rule_removed: The reminder was removed before it was due.
reasons.rule_off: The reminder was switched off before it was sent.
reasons.rescheduled: The appointment was moved, so this was replaced.
reasons.expired: It was too late to send.
reasons.no_contact_point: The contact has no number or address for this channel.
reasons.no_sender: No connected sender for this channel.
reasons.template_required: WhatsApp needs an approved template outside the 24 hour window.
reasons.template_unavailable: The chosen WhatsApp template cannot be sent.
reasons.quiet_hours_too_late: Quiet hours ran past the start.
reasons.do_not_call: The number is on the do-not-call list.
reasons.minor: The contact is flagged as a minor.
reasons.quiet_hours: Waiting for quiet hours to end.
reasons.channel_unavailable: The channel is not connected right now.
reasons.interrupted: It was interrupted and not retried.

notice.smsRemoved: SMS reminders were removed. This step was moved to email (or switched off); choose WhatsApp or Email.

reminders.buttonsTitle: Add Confirm, Reschedule and Cancel buttons (WhatsApp)
reminders.skipIfConfirmed: Skip if the customer already confirmed
reminders.fallbackTitle: If not delivered, try the next channel after (minutes)
reminders.fallbackHint: Leave empty to switch off. From {min} to {maxMinutes} minutes.
